rationale: All three are EOS-sharpening edits on late MLP down_proj: amplify (alpha<0) the <|im_end|> unembedding direction ((1+g_final)*E[eos]) only in the 64 neurons that most promote EOS. The goal is to stop degenerate loops (1/3 of base failures). 184512_099 (L23 only, alpha=-1.5, 64 cols): gen 0.625 vs base 0.50 (8 rescues, 2 losses), cut 0.125 vs 0.1875, neutral -0.0099, probes ~0. 190259_353 (same plus L22): gen 0.50 (6/6), inst 0.606, cut 0.125. 190300_554 (eos64 + EOS-minus-newline on 32 neurons): gen 0.50 (8/8), cut 0.104, but it drops P.S./end phrases. Every EOS variant lowers the cap-hit rate. The strict-accuracy gain of #1 did not survive a small change (#2), so it is weak evidence. Ranking: #1 by its gen result, #2 by higher inst_strict and fewer side effects than #3. Probe metrics did not predict generation, except that a negative postscript per_constraint predicted lost P.S./end-phrase compliance (eosnn_n32 gen 0.4375).
